1.text: Nuko umunsi w'isabato ushize, ku wa mbere w'iminsi irindwi, umuseke wenda gutambika, Mariya Magadalena na Mariya wundi bajya kureba cya gituro.

2.text: Habaho igishyitsi cyinshi, kuko marayika w'Umwami Imana yari amanutse avuye mu ijuru, abirindura igitare acyicaraho.

3.text: Ishusho ye yasaga n'umurabyo, n'imyenda ye yeraga nk'urubura.

4.text: Ba barinzi bamubonye bagira ubwoba bahinda imishitsi, basa n'abapfuye.

5.text: Ariko marayika abwira abagore ati “Mwebweho mwitinya, kuko nzi yuko mushaka Yesu wabambwe.

6.text: Ntari hano kuko yazutse nk'uko yavuze, nimuze murebe aho Umwami yari aryamye.

7.text: Nimugende vuba mubwire abigishwa be yuko yazutse, kandi azababanziriza kujya i Galilaya. Iyo ni ho muzamubonera dore ndabibabwiye.”

8.text: Bava mu gituro vuba bafite ubwoba n'ibinezaneza byinshi, birukanka bajya kubibwira abigishwa be.

9.text: Maze Yesu ahura na bo arababwira ati “Ni amahoro!” Baramwegera bamufata ku birenge, baramupfukamira.

10.text: Maze Yesu arababwira ati “Mwitinya, nimugende mubwire bene Data bajye i Galilaya, ni ho bazambonera.”

11.text: Bakigenda, bamwe muri ba barinzi bajya mu murwa babwira abatambyi bakuru ibyabaye byose.

12.text: Bateranira hamwe n'abakuru bajya inama, bagurira abasirikare ifeza nyinshi

13.text: bati “Mujye muvuga muti ‘Abigishwa be baje nijoro dusinziriye, baramwiba.’

14.text: Umutegeka naramuka abyumvise tuzamwemeza, namwe tuzabakiza amakuba.”

15.text: Nuko baherako bijyanira ifeza, babigenza uko bohejwe. Iryo jambo ryamamara mu Bayuda na bugingo n'ubu.

16.text: Nuko abigishwa cumi n'umwe bajya i Galilaya ku musozi Yesu yabategetse.

18.text: Nuko Yesu arabegera avugana na bo ati “Nahawe ubutware bwose mu ijuru no mu isi.

19.text: Nuko mugende muhindure abantu bo mu mahanga yose abigishwa, mubabatiza mu izina rya Data wa twese n'Umwana n'Umwuka Wera,

20.text: mubigisha kwitondera ibyo nababwiye byose. Kandi dore ndi kumwe namwe iminsi yose kugeza ku mperuka y'isi.”
